title: ① Belgian Consumers See K-Beauty as More Than a Trend
summary: Editor\'s Note: As K-beauty continues to strengthen its presence across Europe, Beauty Economy conducted interviews with five consumers in Belgium to better understand how European consumers perceive Korean beauty products and what factors influence their purchasing decisions.In Part 1, we examine co

extraction.key_fact: 벨기에 소비자들은 한국 화장품을 단순한 유행을 넘어 우수한 효능과 전통 원료의 차별성을 갖춘 신뢰도 높은 제품군으로 평가하고 있다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: The interviews reveal that Belgian consumers view K-beauty as a category built on quality, ingredient innovation, and strong value.

ingredients.name: ginseng
ingredients.quote: Since the early 2010s, K-beauty has differentiated itself through the development of skincare and cosmetic products featuring traditional Korean ingredients such as ginseng.

ingredients.name: rice
ingredients.quote: Respondents cited ingredients such as ginseng, rice, and mung bean as key differentiators that set Korean beauty products apart from many Western brands.
